### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b03/answers/typing-chat-bot.txt ### Chat
state convs=[{"id":1,"title":"Debounce a search input","day":"Today"},{"id":2,"title":"Quarterly churn summary","day":"Today"},{"id":3,"title":"Trip plan: Lisbon","day":"Yesterday"},{"id":4,"title":"SQL window functions","day":"Yesterday"},{"id":5,"title":"Cover letter edits","day":"Last week"}]
state current=1
state sel=0
state newTitle=""
state model="Sidekick Pro"
state draft=""
state streaming=false
state shown=0
state words=["Debouncing","delays","a","function","call","until","the","user","has","stopped","typing.","Here","is","a","small","helper","and","a","comparison","of","the","options."]
state upload=1
state fileName="churn-q3.csv"
state attached=true
state messages=[{"id":1,"role":"user","text":"How do I debounce a search input in JavaScript?","vote":""},{"id":2,"role":"bot","text":"Wrap the handler so it only runs after the user stops typing for a short delay. **Debounce** resets a timer on every keystroke, while *throttle* runs at most once per interval.","vote":""}]
state followups=["Show a React hook version","Explain throttle vs debounce","Add a cancel method"]
state q=""
every 250 when streaming onTick={shown=shown+1; streaming=shown+1<length(words)}
every 300 when attached && upload<1 onTick={upload=min(1,upload+0.25)}
App
  Sidebar
    Brand "Sidekick" icon="auto_awesome"
    Button "New chat" icon="add" onTap={current=0; messages=[]}
    Input "Search chats" @q
    Column scroll gap=4 grow
      Text.caption "Today"
      each c in filter(convs,c=>c.day=="Today")
        NavItem "{c.title}" icon="chat_bubble_outline" selected={current==c.id} onTap={current=c.id} menu=convMenu onLongPress={sel=c.id}
      Text.caption "Yesterday"
      each c in filter(convs,c=>c.day=="Yesterday")
        NavItem "{c.title}" icon="chat_bubble_outline" selected={current==c.id} onTap={current=c.id} menu=convMenu
      Text.caption "Last week"
      each c in filter(convs,c=>c.day=="Last week")
        NavItem "{c.title}" icon="chat_bubble_outline" selected={current==c.id} onTap={current=c.id} menu=convMenu
    Avatar "Maya Reyes" size=32
  Main
    Nav
      Heading "{find(convs,c=>c.id==current).title}" level=3
      Row gap=8
        Button.outline "{model}" icon="expand_more" onTap={open modelMenu}
        IconButton "more_vert" tooltip="Conversation options" onTap={sel=current; open convMenu}
    Column pad=24 gap=16 scroll maxw=820
      each m in messages
        if m.role=="user"
          Row end
            ChatBubble "{m.text}" role="user"
        if m.role=="bot"
          Column gap=8
            ChatBubble role="assistant" markdown text="{m.text}"
            CodeBlock language="javascript" code="function debounce(fn, wait = 300) {\n  let timer;\n  return (...args) => {\n    clearTimeout(timer);\n    timer = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), wait);\n  };\n}" onCopy={copy result; toast "Code copied"}
            Table columns=["Technique","Runs","Best for"] rows=[["Debounce","After typing stops","Search boxes"],["Throttle","Once per interval","Scroll, resize"]]
            Image "https://images.example.com/diagrams/debounce-timeline.png" radius=8 h=160
            Row gap=4
              IconButton "thumb_up" tooltip="Good answer" selected={m.vote=="up"} onTap={messages=updateWhere(messages,x=>x.id==m.id,x=>with(x,"vote","up"))}
              IconButton "thumb_down" tooltip="Bad answer" selected={m.vote=="down"} onTap={messages=updateWhere(messages,x=>x.id==m.id,x=>with(x,"vote","down"))}
              IconButton "content_copy" tooltip="Copy" onTap={copy m.text; toast "Copied"}
      if streaming
        Column gap=8
          ChatBubble role="assistant" streaming markdown text="{join(take(words,shown),' ')}"
          Row gap=8
            Progress.indeterminate
            Button.outline "Stop" icon="stop" onTap={streaming=false}
      if !streaming
        Row gap=8 scroll
          each f in followups
            Chip "{f}" onTap={draft=f}
    Footer
      Column pad=16 gap=8
        if attached
          Row gap=8
            Chip "{fileName}" icon="attach_file" onDelete={attached=false; upload=0}
            Progress value={upload} w=160
            Text.caption "{round(upload*100,0)}%"
        Row gap=8
          IconButton "attach_file" tooltip="Attach a file" onTap={attached=true; upload=0; fileName="churn-q3.csv"}
          Input "Message Sidekick" @draft multiline grow onSubmit={draft!="" ? {messages=append(messages,{"id":length(messages)+1,"role":"user","text":draft,"vote":""}); draft=""; shown=0; streaming=true} : toast "Type a message"}
          if streaming
            IconButton "stop_circle" tooltip="Stop generating" onTap={streaming=false}
          if !streaming
            IconButton "send" tooltip="Send" onTap={draft!="" ? {messages=append(messages,{"id":length(messages)+1,"role":"user","text":draft,"vote":""}); draft=""; shown=0; streaming=true} : toast "Type a message"}
Menu#modelMenu end
  MenuItem "Sidekick Pro" icon="bolt" onTap={model="Sidekick Pro"}
  MenuItem "Sidekick Fast" icon="speed" onTap={model="Sidekick Fast"}
  MenuItem "Sidekick Mini" icon="eco" onTap={model="Sidekick Mini"}
Menu#convMenu
  MenuItem "Rename" icon="edit" onTap={newTitle=find(convs,c=>c.id==sel).title; open renameChat}
  MenuItem "Delete" icon="delete" onTap={open deleteChat}
Dialog#renameChat "Rename chat" "Give it a name you will recognise"
  Input "Title" @newTitle
  Row end gap=8
    Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
    Button "Save" onTap={newTitle!="" ? {convs=updateWhere(convs,c=>c.id==sel,c=>with(c,"title",newTitle)); toast "Renamed"; close} : toast "Enter a title"}
Dialog#deleteChat "Delete this chat?" "This cannot be undone."
  Row end gap=8
    Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
    Button.destructive "Delete" onTap={convs=removeWhere(convs,c=>c.id==sel); current=first(convs).id; toast "Chat deleted"; close}
### tool/vocabulary/corpus-define/d02/answers/flight-tracker.txt ### Alerts
state gateAlert=true
state delayAlert=true
state landAlert=false
state boardAlert=true
state beltAlert=false
state channel="Push"
state minutes=30
App
  Sidebar
    Brand "Contrail" icon="flight"
    NavItem "Search" icon="search" onTap={go search}
    NavItem "My flight" icon="flight_takeoff" onTap={go flight}
    NavItem "Departures" icon="departure_board" onTap={go departures}
    NavItem "Alerts" icon="notifications" selected badge="2" onTap={go alerts}
  Main
    Nav
      Heading "Alerts for BA117" level=1
      Button "Save" onTap={toast "Alerts saved"; go flight}
    Column pad=24 gap=16 maxw=720
      Card gap=4
        Toggle "Gate changes" @gateAlert
        Toggle "Delays over 15 minutes" @delayAlert
        Toggle "Boarding starts" @boardAlert
        Toggle "Landing" @landAlert
        Toggle "Baggage belt assigned" @beltAlert
      Card gap=8
        Text.panelTitle "Notify me by"
        SegmentedButton @channel items=["Push","Email","SMS"]
        Text.fieldLabel "Boarding reminder: {minutes} min before"
        Slider @minutes min=10 max=90
      Text.muted "You will get {count([gateAlert,delayAlert,boardAlert,landAlert,beltAlert], x=>x)} kinds of alert by {lower(channel)}."
### tool/vocabulary/corpus-define/d02/answers/typing-chat-bot.txt ### Chat
state convs=[{"id":1,"title":"Debounce a search input","day":"Today"},{"id":2,"title":"Trip plan for Lisbon","day":"Today"},{"id":3,"title":"SQL window functions","day":"Yesterday"},{"id":4,"title":"Cover letter edits","day":"Yesterday"},{"id":5,"title":"Sourdough starter help","day":"Earlier this week"}]
state current=1
state sel=0
state renameText=""
state model="Sidekick 4 Sonnet"
state draft=""
state streaming=false
state words=["A","debounce","delays","running","a","function","until","the","user","has","stopped","typing","for","a","set","time.","Here","is","a","small","version","in","Dart,","and","a","comparison","of","delays:"]
state shown=0
state vote=""
state attached=false
state progress=0
state fileName="search_spec.pdf"
state followups=["Add a cancel method","Show it in Flutter","Compare with throttle"]
state q=""
every 120 when streaming onTick={shown=shown+1; shown>=length(words) ? streaming=false : shown=shown}
every 200 when attached && progress<1 onTick={progress=min(1,progress+0.1)}
App
  Sidebar
    Brand "Sidekick" icon="auto_awesome"
    Button "New chat" icon="add" onTap={current=0; shown=0; toast "New chat"}
    Input "Search chats" @q
    Column scroll grow gap=4
      each day in unique(map(convs,c=>c.day))
        Text.caption "{upper(day)}"
        each c in filter(convs,x=>x.day==day)
          Row between middle
            NavItem "{c.title}" selected={current==c.id} grow onTap={current=c.id}
            IconButton "more_vert" tooltip="Conversation options" onTap={sel=c.id; open convMenu}
    Text.muted "Ada Lovelace"
  Main
    Nav
      Heading "{find(convs,c=>c.id==current).title}"
      Row gap=8 middle
        Button.outline "{model}" icon="expand_more" onTap={open modelMenu}
        IconButton "ios_share" tooltip="Share"
    Column scroll pad=24 gap=16 maxw=720
      ChatBubble role="user"
        Text "How do I debounce a search input? Here is the spec, too."
        if attached
          FileChip "{fileName}" progress={progress} onRemove={attached=false; progress=0}
      ChatBubble role="assistant"
        Markdown "{join(take(words,shown)," ")}"
        if shown>=length(words)
          CodeBlock lang="dart" code="Timer? _t;\nvoid onChanged(String q) {\n  _t?.cancel();\n  _t = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 300), () => search(q));\n}"
          Table columns=["Delay","Feels","Requests"] rows=[["150 ms","Snappy","High"],["300 ms","Balanced","Medium"],["600 ms","Sluggish","Low"]]
          Image "https://images.example.com/diagrams/debounce-timeline.png" h=180 radius=8
        if streaming
          Row gap=8 middle
            Progress value={shown}
            Button.outline "Stop" icon="stop" onTap={streaming=false}
        if !streaming && shown>=length(words)
          Row gap=4
            IconButton "content_copy" tooltip="Copy answer" onTap={copy join(words," "); toast "Copied"}
            IconButton "thumb_up" tooltip="Good answer" selected={vote=="up"} onTap={vote="up"; emit feedback "up"}
            IconButton "thumb_down" tooltip="Bad answer" selected={vote=="down"} onTap={vote="down"; emit feedback "down"}
            IconButton "refresh" tooltip="Regenerate" onTap={shown=0; streaming=true}
      if !streaming && shown>=length(words)
        Row scroll gap=8
          each f in followups
            Chip "{f}" onTap={draft=f}
    Footer
      Column pad=12 gap=8
        if attached
          FileChip "{fileName}" progress={progress} onRemove={attached=false; progress=0}
        Row gap=8 middle
          IconButton "attach_file" tooltip="Attach a file" onTap={attached=true; progress=0}
          Input "Message Sidekick" @draft multiline grow
          Button "Send" icon="send" onTap={draft!="" ? {shown=0; streaming=true; draft=""} : toast "Type a message"}
  Menu#convMenu
    MenuItem "Rename" icon="edit" onTap={renameText=find(convs,c=>c.id==sel).title; open renameDlg}
    MenuItem "Delete" icon="delete" onTap={open deleteDlg}
  Menu#modelMenu end
    MenuItem "Sidekick 4 Sonnet" icon="bolt" onTap={model="Sidekick 4 Sonnet"}
    MenuItem "Sidekick 4 Opus" icon="psychology" onTap={model="Sidekick 4 Opus"}
    MenuItem "Sidekick 4 Haiku" icon="speed" onTap={model="Sidekick 4 Haiku"}
  Dialog#renameDlg "Rename chat"
    Input "Title" @renameText
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
      Button "Save" onTap={convs=updateWhere(convs,c=>c.id==sel,c=>with(c,"title",renameText)); toast "Renamed"; close}
  Dialog#deleteDlg "Delete this chat?" "This cannot be undone."
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
      Button.destructive "Delete" onTap={convs=removeWhere(convs,c=>c.id==sel); toast "Chat deleted"; close}
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b08/answers/keyboard-only-mail.txt ### Inbox
state sel=0
state openId=""
state q=""
state cmd=""
state cmdSel=0
state labelQ=""
state snoozeText=""
state labels=["Work","Receipts","Travel","Family","Follow up"]
state msgs=[{"id":"m1","from":"Priya Nair","subject":"Q3 roadmap review notes","preview":"Attached are the notes from Tuesday. Two items need your call before Friday.","time":"9:41 AM","unread":true,"labels":["Work"],"body":"Hi,\n\nAttached are the notes from Tuesday's review. Two items need your call before Friday: the billing migration date and whether we staff the mobile pilot.\n\nThanks,\nPriya"},{"id":"m2","from":"Lufthansa","subject":"Your boarding pass for LH 457","preview":"Check-in is open. Your seat is 23A, gate B22.","time":"8:15 AM","unread":true,"labels":["Travel"],"body":"Check-in is open for LH 457 to Frankfurt. Seat 23A, gate B22, boarding 17:40."},{"id":"m3","from":"Marcus Ortega","subject":"Re: Dinner on Saturday?","preview":"Seven works. I booked the corner table.","time":"Yesterday","unread":false,"labels":["Family"],"body":"Seven works. I booked the corner table at Alma. Bring Dana if she is free."},{"id":"m4","from":"Stripe","subject":"Your receipt from Figma, $45.00","preview":"Receipt #2041-8830. Paid with Visa ending 4242.","time":"Yesterday","unread":false,"labels":["Receipts"],"body":"Receipt #2041-8830 for Figma Professional, $45.00, paid with Visa ending 4242."},{"id":"m5","from":"Hannah Berg","subject":"Contract redlines","preview":"I accepted most of your changes. Section 4 still needs a second look.","time":"Mon","unread":false,"labels":["Work","Follow up"],"body":"I accepted most of your changes. Section 4 still needs a second look, especially the termination clause."}]
state commands=[{"name":"Archive message","key":"e"},{"name":"Snooze message","key":"b"},{"name":"Apply label","key":"l"},{"name":"Compose new message","key":"c"},{"name":"Reply","key":"r"},{"name":"Mark as unread","key":"u"},{"name":"Go to inbox","key":"g i"},{"name":"Show keyboard shortcuts","key":"?"}]
Hotkey "j" onPress={sel=min(sel+1,length(msgs)-1)}
Hotkey "k" onPress={sel=max(sel-1,0)}
Hotkey "ArrowDown" onPress={sel=min(sel+1,length(msgs)-1)}
Hotkey "ArrowUp" onPress={sel=max(sel-1,0)}
Hotkey "Enter" onPress={openId=msgs[sel].id; go message}
Hotkey "e" onPress={msgs=removeAt(msgs,sel); sel=clamp(sel,0,max(length(msgs)-1,0)); toast "Archived. Press z to undo"}
Hotkey "b" onPress={snoozeText=""; open snooze}
Hotkey "l" onPress={labelQ=""; open labels}
Hotkey "c" onPress={go compose}
Hotkey "?" onPress={open help}
Hotkey "ctrl+k" onPress={cmd=""; cmdSel=0; open commands}
Hotkey "/" onPress={focus search}
App
  Sidebar
    Brand "Tabline" icon="keyboard"
    NavItem "Inbox" icon="inbox" badge="2" selected={true} hint="g i"
    NavItem "Snoozed" icon="schedule" hint="g s"
    NavItem "Archive" icon="archive" hint="g a"
    NavItem "Drafts" icon="edit_note" hint="g d"
    Text.caption "LABELS"
    each l in labels
      NavItem "{l}" icon="label" onTap={q="label:{l}"}
    Spacer grow
    Button.ghost "Shortcuts  ?" icon="help" onTap={open help}
  Main
    Nav
      Heading "Inbox" level=1
      Row gap=8
        Input#search "Search mail" "Press / to focus" @q w=240
        Button.outline "Command bar  Ctrl K" icon="terminal" onTap={cmd=""; cmdSel=0; open commands}
        Button "Compose  c" icon="edit" onTap={go compose}
    Column pad=24 gap=8
      Text.muted "{length(msgs)} conversations. j and k move, Enter opens, e archives, b snoozes, l labels."
      each m in msgs
        Row#row-{m.id} gap=12 pad=12 radius=8 focusable outline=#FF1A73E8 selected={index==sel} fill={index==sel ? "#FFE8F0FE" : "#00000000"} border-left={index==sel ? "#FF1A73E8" : "#00000000"} onTap={sel=index; openId=m.id; go message}
          Icon "{m.unread ? 'mark_email_unread' : 'drafts'}"
          Text.strong "{m.from}" w=140
          Column grow gap=2
            Text.strong "{m.subject}"
            Text.muted "{m.preview}"
          Row gap=4
            each lb in m.labels
              Badge.info "{lb}"
          Text.caption "{m.time}" w=80
  Dialog#help "Keyboard shortcuts" "Every key in Tabline"
    Grid cols=2 gap=24
      Column gap=6
        Text.sectionTitle "Move"
        Row between
          Text "Next message"
          Text.mono "j  or  Down"
        Row between
          Text "Previous message"
          Text.mono "k  or  Up"
        Row between
          Text "Open message"
          Text.mono "Enter"
        Row between
          Text "Back to list"
          Text.mono "Esc"
        Row between
          Text "Focus search"
          Text.mono "/"
        Text.sectionTitle "Go to"
        Row between
          Text "Inbox"
          Text.mono "g i"
        Row between
          Text "Snoozed"
          Text.mono "g s"
        Row between
          Text "Archive"
          Text.mono "g a"
      Column gap=6
        Text.sectionTitle "Act"
        Row between
          Text "Archive"
          Text.mono "e"
        Row between
          Text "Snooze"
          Text.mono "b"
        Row between
          Text "Apply label"
          Text.mono "l"
        Row between
          Text "Reply"
          Text.mono "r"
        Row between
          Text "Mark unread"
          Text.mono "u"
        Text.sectionTitle "Compose"
        Row between
          Text "New message"
          Text.mono "c"
        Row between
          Text "Next field"
          Text.mono "Tab"
        Row between
          Text "Send"
          Text.mono "Ctrl Enter"
        Text.sectionTitle "Anywhere"
        Row between
          Text "Command bar"
          Text.mono "Ctrl K"
        Row between
          Text "This help"
          Text.mono "?"
    Button "Close  Esc" onTap={close}
  Dialog#commands "Command bar"
    Input#cmdInput "Type a command" "archive, snooze, label..." @cmd autofocus onChange={cmdSel=0}
    Hotkey "ArrowDown" onPress={cmdSel=min(cmdSel+1,length(filter(commands,c=>contains(lower(c.name),lower(cmd))))-1)}
    Hotkey "ArrowUp" onPress={cmdSel=max(cmdSel-1,0)}
    Column gap=2
      each c in filter(commands,c=>contains(lower(c.name),lower(cmd)))
        Row between pad=10 radius=6 focusable outline=#FF1A73E8 fill={index==cmdSel ? "#FFE8F0FE" : "#00000000"} onTap={close; emit runCommand c.name}
          Text "{c.name}"
          Text.mono "{c.key}"
      if length(filter(commands,c=>contains(lower(c.name),lower(cmd))))==0
        Text.muted "No command matches {cmd}"
    Text.caption "Up and Down choose, Enter runs, Esc closes"
  Dialog#snooze "Snooze until" "Type a time: tomorrow nine, mon 8am, in 3 hours"
    Input#snoozeInput "When" "tomorrow nine" @snoozeText autofocus onSubmit={msgs=removeAt(msgs,sel); sel=clamp(sel,0,max(length(msgs)-1,0)); toast "Snoozed until {parseTime(snoozeText)}"; close}
    Row gap=8
      Chip "tomorrow nine" onTap={snoozeText="tomorrow nine"}
      Chip "tonight six" onTap={snoozeText="tonight six"}
      Chip "monday eight" onTap={snoozeText="monday eight"}
    if snoozeText!=""
      Text.muted "Will return {parseTime(snoozeText)}"
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Cancel  Esc" onTap={close}
      Button "Snooze  Enter" onTap={msgs=removeAt(msgs,sel); sel=clamp(sel,0,max(length(msgs)-1,0)); toast "Snoozed until {parseTime(snoozeText)}"; close}
  Dialog#labels "Apply labels" "Type to filter, Enter to toggle"
    Input#labelInput "Label" "Work, Travel..." @labelQ autofocus onSubmit={msgs=updateWhere(msgs,m=>m.id==msgs[sel].id,m=>with(m,"labels",contains(m.labels,first(filter(labels,l=>contains(lower(l),lower(labelQ))))) ? without(m.labels,first(filter(labels,l=>contains(lower(l),lower(labelQ))))) : append(m.labels,first(filter(labels,l=>contains(lower(l),lower(labelQ)))))))}
    Column gap=2
      each l in filter(labels,l=>contains(lower(l),lower(labelQ)))
        Row between pad=10 radius=6 focusable outline=#FF1A73E8 onTap={msgs=updateWhere(msgs,m=>m.id==msgs[sel].id,m=>with(m,"labels",contains(m.labels,l) ? without(m.labels,l) : append(m.labels,l)))}
          Text "{l}"
          if contains(msgs[sel].labels,l)
            Icon "check"
    Button "Done" onTap={close}

state tab="orders"
App

    NavItem "Orders" icon="receipt_long" selected={tab=="orders"} onTap={tab="orders"}
  Main
    Text "Orders"
